extension.summary: Shared install library for the Tony.7.Bones Setup add-ons
extension.description: Internal Python library used by the Tony.7.Bones Setup add-ons. It is not runnable on its own and does not appear on the home screen; it provides the shared add-on install, dependency-resolution and Kodi-integration machinery the Setup add-ons depend on.
extension.news: v1.2.0: Modular Setup layers — re-entrant apply_foundation/apply_iptv/apply_addons (each leaves a complete working box), installed-state probes + assert_box_complete (dependency-closure walk), the PVR-disabled config window for pvr.iptvsimple instance-settings writes, staged-IPTV artifact consumption (host-built m3u/groups/instance files), keep-skin activation hardening (verify-then-re-assert with skinshortcuts quiescence), and the SETUP_API version guard.
